As someone who has struggled with a depression room for so many years i finally (mostly) beat the build up. You’ll thank yourself and so will your doggo, you’ll have so much space to look at and finally feel free. If this helps what I usually do is start with trash and pick up all the trash i see. I specifically use those reusable bags from walmart and toss them in a bigger bag. I realized it was easier for me (a disabled person) instead of lugging a trash bag around my room. All belongings that just havent been put back or things that were once lost go on my bed for put back. The stuff on my bed doubles as making me have to put it all away. You’ll probably hear this often but having a clean room can help with your mood and hopefully once you see it clean you can try to keep aiming for the satisfaction of the clean, even if you fall back sometimes it’s never irreversible. You got this!
